question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the aircraft accidents and incidents involving the airline's aircraft from the late 1950s to the mid-2010s.
criterion: an accident or incident in which an aircraft of the airline (including its predecessor Deutsche Flugdienst) crashed, collided, made a forced or emergency landing, or was damaged in a ground incident
why_needs_multiple: Sáu sự cố tàu bay cùng label accident; tổng hợp phải đủ cả sáu mốc.

gold_events.text: Deutsche Flugdienst Viking cargo flight forced landing in Belgium; aircraft destroyed.
Convair engine failures; emergency landing short of Rimini runway, one passenger died.
Condor 737-100 collided with a Piper light aircraft near Tarragona.
Flight 3782 crashed near Izmir, killing all 16 on board.
767-300 hit a TV mast on El Copey after a wrong turn; no one injured.
A321 left wing struck a light tower while being towed; technician injured.

question: List, in chronological order, the dated events in which the airline changed its operating or brand name after its founding, including a return to an earlier name.
